newsitem.title: RUSSIA: UES, Russia work on convertible issue.
newsitem.headline: UES, Russia work on convertible issue.

text.p: Russia's Privatisation Ministry and national electricity company Unified Energy System (UES) are working on a scheme to sell a 1.5 percent government-owned stake of UES through a convertible bond, probably this autumn, privatisation minister Alfred Kokh said on Thursday.

"We have formed a working group together with UES which is developing a scheme to sell a 1.5 percent stake in the form of convertible securities," he told a news conference. He said he expected the plan to be ready by autumn.
